text_to_image_prompt:
Output one image, aspect ratio 1105:1424 (approximately 0.776:1), target canvas 1105 × 1424 pixels.

Create one independent photorealistic studio portrait on a completely seamless pure white #FFFFFF background. Bright soft frontal light, balanced fill, low contrast, faint optical halation, natural pores and fine facial hair, detailed real cotton and knit fabric, realistic 50mm perspective, both eyes sharp and background clean. No room, scenery, props, gradient, vignette, frame, collage, text, branding or watermark. Keep the entire hairstyle inside the frame with a small white margin. One fictional young adult woman, approximately 18–22 years old, with long sleek dark-chestnut hair with middle part, warm olive skin, deep brown eyes, naturally thick brows, softly pointed oval jaw, straight narrow nose and full rose lips; black sleeveless vest layered over white long-sleeve tee, composed straight gaze. Frame a close head-and-shoulders to mid-torso portrait, both shoulders visible, gaze toward camera, subject large in frame; retain the specifically described head angle and pose. Clean lightly flushed natural skin and light everyday makeup, no heavy eyeliner or glossy beauty retouching.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。

Create a new South Asian American girl with long espresso-brown hair, deep brown eyes, soft natural rose lip, calm direct gaze, black knit sleeveless shell layered over a cream long-sleeve shirt. Centered chest-up portrait.
